description: This file implements voice activation and push-to-talk functionality for a macOS application, including hotkey detection, speech recognition, and speech overlay management.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Manages global and local hotkey monitoring to trigger voice recognition start and end actions based on right Option key presses.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Handles the speech recognition process during push-to-talk, managing AVAudioEngine, Speech recognizer, and overlay updates.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Sets up global and local monitors for key modifier changes.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Removes monitors and resets modifier states.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state when right Option (key code 61) is pressed or released; triggers start or stop of voice capture.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts speech recognition session for push-to-talk.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and finalizes audio transcription.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Speech recognizer and audio engine.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes partial and final speech transcription results during recognition.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and reports the recognized text, cleans up speech recognition resources.
